candidates.audience: People planning roofing work on properties confirmed within City of Chicago jurisdiction
candidates.offer: Use city building-permit guidance and Illinois licensing records to compare a roofing project scope. No lead collection or booking.
candidates.headline: Chicago reroofing: permits, licensing and scope checks
candidates.subhead: Five checks to make before hiring a roofer, backed by the City of Chicago and Illinois licensing guidance.
candidates.summary: A citywide research checklist for properties under Chicago jurisdiction. Check the actual address and project before relying on permit rules. no contractor referral or sale is offered.

local_facts.statement: Chicago's Express Permit guidance identifies reroofing work as a distinct eligible project category, subject to the stated conditions and limitations.
local_facts.source_ref: Chicago Department of Buildings: Express Permit eligibility, reroofing

local_facts.statement: The City of Chicago explains that permits are generally needed for most construction and repair work. Check the precise project and property circumstances against the current city guidance.
local_facts.source_ref: City of Chicago: Building Permit Application Instructions

local_facts.statement: Chicago's permit-application status service provides public access to limited application information by property address. it does not guarantee a complete historical permit record.
local_facts.source_ref: City of Chicago: Building Permit Application Status Help

local_facts.statement: Illinois provides an official professional-licence lookup. Verify the roofing contractor's current licensing status directly before engaging a provider.

The Census Bureau's ZIP Code Tabulation Areas are approximate geographic representations, not the same as USPS delivery ZIP codes. neither alone establishes a specific property's municipal jurisdiction.
local_facts.source_ref: US Census Bureau: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas

research_steps: Confirm the property is within City of Chicago jurisdiction using its actual street address. ZIP codes and census ZCTAs alone do not establish jurisdiction.
Identify the roof type, slope, building height, number of units and proposed work before checking Chicago's reroofing permit or exemption guidance.
Ask every shortlisted roofer for their legal business name and licensing details, then independently check the current Illinois licensing record.
Check the City of Chicago's permit application status tools for the property's address, allowing for limits on older or incomplete records.
Compare written scopes that describe materials, existing roof layers, structural work, insulation, clean-up, warranties and responsibility for any needed permits.
